statement: Complimentary weekday entry to the Pt. Leo Estate Sculpture Park was offered to permanent residents of Mornington Peninsula Shire and Frankston, and to nobody else.
note: This is the third reading of entry in the corpus, and it is the narrow one: time limited, weekdays only, residents only. It is the reason the free assertions elsewhere look defensible at a glance and are not. The offer window has passed, so any surface still presenting it as available is wrong. Authored by hand for the PI-005 Stage 2 pilot on the Pt. Leo Estate sculpture park cluster. Sources were read on 2026-09-13; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-13-pilot-pt-leo-sculpture-park.md.
